metadata.title: Public Health Analytics-OS knowledge graph contract
metadata.principle: Official source manifestations remain distinct; graph links support discovery and lineage and never imply equivalence unless explicitly typed and evidenced.

nodeTypes.IndicatorConcept: A source-neutral analytical concept used to organize distinct official indicator manifestations.
nodeTypes.IndicatorManifestation: A named, versioned indicator definition published by a source custodian.
nodeTypes.HmisObject: A derived HMIS indicator, data element, published output or validation rule.
nodeTypes.SourceDocument: A source publication or catalogue with an explicit version and coverage boundary.
nodeTypes.Organization: An organization responsible for publishing or maintaining a source.
nodeTypes.Programme: A public-health programme or programme family.
nodeTypes.ProgrammeComponent: An operational component within a programme.
nodeTypes.WHOBuildingBlock: One of the six canonical WHO health-system building blocks.
nodeTypes.ReportingLevel: A normalized lowest reporting level used for navigation.
nodeTypes.EvidenceGap: A declared limitation preventing source completeness or crosswalk verification.

edgeTypes.manifestationOf: Connects an official indicator manifestation to a source-neutral concept. Requires a mappingRelation and rationale.
edgeTypes.definedBy: Connects an indicator or HMIS object to its source document or catalogue.
edgeTypes.publishedBy: Connects a source document to its responsible organization.
edgeTypes.partOfProgramme: Connects an indicator, HMIS object or evidence gap to a programme.
edgeTypes.hasProgrammeComponent: Connects an indicator to a normalized programme component.
edgeTypes.supportsBuildingBlock: Analytical mapping to a WHO health-system building block; not a source-custodian assertion unless stated.
edgeTypes.lowestReportingLevel: Connects an indicator to a normalized lowest reporting level while preserving the source label on the edge.
edgeTypes.hasMeasureType: Connects an indicator to its normalized measure type.
edgeTypes.usesDataElement: Curated link from an indicator or derived HMIS measure to an HMIS data element.
edgeTypes.relatedIndicator: Curated discovery link between distinct indicator manifestations; does not imply mathematical comparability.
edgeTypes.relatedHmisObject: A typed HMIS relationship whose exact operational semantics remain source-governed.
edgeTypes.limitsCompletenessOf: Connects a declared evidence gap to the affected programme.

mappingRelations.exactMatch: Definitions and operational semantics are judged equivalent within the stated version and context.
mappingRelations.closeMatch: Conceptually close but one or more operational details prevent an exact-equivalence assertion.
mappingRelations.broadMatch: The concept represented by the source manifestation is broader than the target concept.
mappingRelations.narrowMatch: The concept represented by the source manifestation is narrower than the target concept.
mappingRelations.relatedMatch: The records are useful to navigate together but do not have a hierarchical or equivalence relation.

assertionStatuses.official: Explicitly asserted by the cited source.
assertionStatuses.curated: Reviewed analytical assertion made by Public Health Analytics-OS.
assertionStatuses.normalized: Deterministic mapping from a preserved source label to a controlled term.
assertionStatuses.candidate: Provisional relationship requiring domain or custodian review.

schemaOrg.DataCatalog: The Analytics-OS registry as a public metadata catalogue.
schemaOrg.Dataset: The Immunization graph release and its declared distributions.
schemaOrg.StatisticalVariable: An indicator definition; actual programme values are not represented in this pilot.
schemaOrg.DefinedTermSet: Controlled vocabularies such as programmes, building blocks, reporting levels and measure types.
schemaOrg.DefinedTerm: A controlled concept within a DefinedTermSet.
schemaOrg.measurementDenominator: A denominator-variable description for percentages and ratios.
schemaOrg.measurementMethod: The normalized formula or source-defined aggregation method.
schemaOrg.isBasedOn: The official source from which an indicator manifestation was derived.

standardsProfile.provO: Attribution and derivation provenance for graph assertions.
standardsProfile.shacl: Future RDF graph validation; the pilot enforces equivalent constraints in the build validator.
